verdict.rationale: Morph's documented integration path is pointing third-party OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs at its compatible endpoints (/v1, /v1/messages). That is protocol compatibility with other vendors' SDKs, not a Morph-published official SDK. Docs URLs sit under an /sdk/ path, but no cited content shows an installable first-party Morph SDK package, so the capability is unevidenced.
